result:
The chart type gallery now shows on a saved trends insight in view mode, in place of the plain dropdown. I haven't run any tests or typecheck.

The change is in `products/product_analytics/frontend/insights/chartAlternatives/chartAlternativesLogic.ts`. The `isEditableSurface` selector used to require edit mode, which sent view mode to the `ChartFilter` dropdown fallback. I removed that requirement and dropped the now-unused `editMode` input and its typing from the selector.

Everything else that keeps the dropdown is unchanged:
- The feature flag, the trends-only restriction, embedded, shared and dashboard contexts.
- Users without edit permission, or with an editing-disabled reason.

Edit mode still gets the gallery as before. I didn't add a test: the existing `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` only covers edit mode and doesn't exercise this condition.

In view mode, choosing a chart from the gallery updates the displayed query the way the old dropdown did. I did not look at how the view-mode save flow handles that change.
